action.query: Medi-Cal official California eligibility apply benefits 2026
queries: Medi-Cal official California eligibility apply benefits 2026

content.text:
Medi-Cal is **California’s Medicaid program**—free or low-cost health coverage for eligible California residents. ([dhcs.ca.gov](https://www.dhcs.ca.gov/medi-cal/?utm_source=openai))

You can apply in **4 ways**:

1. **Online:** through **BenefitsCal** or **Covered California**  
2. **By phone:** call your county Medi-Cal office  
3. **In person:** visit your county office  
4. **By mail:** download and mail an application ([dhcs.ca.gov](https://www.dhcs.ca.gov/medi-cal/apply/?utm_source=openai))

**Eligibility** is mainly based on California residency, household size, income, tax filing status, and sometimes property/assets. You do **not** have to file taxes to qualify. ([dhcs.ca.gov](https://www.dhcs.ca.gov/Get-Medi-Cal/Pages/coverage-for-all.aspx?utm_source=openai))

Important 2026 note: California says that starting **January 1, 2026**, new full-scope Medi-Cal enrollment is frozen for certain adults age 19+ who are undocumented and not pregnant; people already enrolled can generally stay covered if they complete annual renewal. ([ca.gov](https://www.ca.gov/departments/217/services/37/?utm_source=openai))
